These plants are often treated as members of genus "Stylocline", but they are not as closely related to "Stylocline" species as they are to plants of other genera, especially "Hesperevax".
Sutrina | Sutrina is a genus of flowering plants from the orchid family, Orchidaceae.  The genus contains only two known species, both endemic to South America.
